meta_title: pepo — a new way to chat
meta_description: A clean, consistent chat client for Twitch — with 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes, followed channels, and a composer that stays out of the way. Cross-platform desktop, open source.
hero_subtitle: A clean, consistent chat client for Twitch — with 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes, followed channels with live status, and a composer that stays out of the way. Cross-platform desktop, open source, and still very early.
tab_emotes_blurb: 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ — static and animated, inline.
tab_following_blurb: Your follow list with live status and viewer counts.
tab_badges_blurb: Subscriber, mod, VIP, partner, and broadcaster badges. Custom username colors.
tab_composer_blurb: Send as your Twitch identity. Emote picker across every set you own.
install_intro: Download the latest release for your platform. Pepo will notify you when updates are available and update itself in-place.
